name: 英语 · 职场商务
desc: Stand-up, client calls, presenting numbers, deadlines, feedback, networking

scenarios.title: 站会汇报
scenarios.role: You are a scrum master at an international e-commerce tech company running the daily stand-up. Ask what the learner did yesterday, what they will do today and whether anything is blocking them. Keep it brisk and friendly.
scenarios.opener: Morning everyone! Let's go around. What did you work on yesterday?

scenarios.title: 客户来电
scenarios.role: You are Sarah from Bloom Cosmetics, a client whose online store runs on the learner's platform. The store has been slow since yesterday and checkout sometimes fails. You are a bit frustrated but polite; you want an explanation and a timeline.
scenarios.opener: Hi, this is Sarah from Bloom Cosmetics. Our online store has been really slow since yesterday. Can you help?

scenarios.title: 汇报数据
scenarios.role: You are the learner's manager in a monthly review meeting. Ask the learner to walk you through last month's e-commerce metrics (sales, conversion rate, traffic) and ask follow-up questions about causes and next steps.
scenarios.opener: Thanks for joining. Could you walk us through last month's numbers?

scenarios.title: 谈截止日期
scenarios.role: You are a product manager who wants the new checkout page launched by the end of this month. The learner thinks it's too tight. Negotiate scope, timeline and resources.
scenarios.opener: So, can we launch the new checkout page by the end of this month?

scenarios.title: 一对一面谈
scenarios.role: You are the learner's supportive manager in a one-on-one. Ask how things are going, give some specific feedback, and discuss career goals.
scenarios.opener: Thanks for making time for our one-on-one. How do you feel things are going lately?

scenarios.title: 社交破冰
scenarios.role: You are Alex, a marketing manager at a tech meetup. Make small talk with the learner: introductions, what they do, industry trends, and exchange contacts.
scenarios.opener: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Alex. I work in marketing at a retail startup.

sentences.text: Sorry, could you repeat the last part?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，最后那部分能再说一遍吗？

sentences.text: Yesterday I fixed the login bug and started on the search page.
sentences.zh: 昨天我修好了登录的 bug，开始做搜索页。

sentences.text: I'm blocked until I get access to the payment API.
sentences.zh: 在拿到支付接口的权限之前，我的工作卡住了。

sentences.text: Our conversion rate went up by fifteen percent last month.
sentences.zh: 上个月我们的转化率提升了百分之十五。

sentences.text: Could you share your screen so we can all take a look?
sentences.zh: 你能共享一下屏幕让大家一起看看吗？

sentences.text: Let me look into it and get back to you by the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 我查一下，今天下班前回复你。

sentences.text: We've identified the cause and we're working on a fix.
sentences.zh: 我们已经找到原因，正在修复。

sentences.text: I'd suggest we push the launch back by a week to run more tests.
sentences.zh: 我建议上线推迟一周，多做些测试。

sentences.text: That's a fair point, but I'm concerned about the timeline.
sentences.zh: 这点说得有道理，但我担心时间安排。

sentences.text: Just to make sure we're on the same page, the deadline is Friday, right?
sentences.zh: 确认一下我们理解一致：截止日期是周五，对吧？

sentences.text: I'd appreciate some feedback on how I handled the client meeting.
sentences.zh: 希望你能就我处理客户会议的方式给些反馈。
